owned_invariants: The task is a public cochain, edges and c, a judge_manifest that names two checkers, and manifest_commitment, text. The sealed part may hold manifest_salt, text. A task that is not of this form is refused before anything is asked.

manifest_commitment_matches is recorded first: manifest_commitment is the SHA-256 of the salt, a zero byte and the canonical form of the whole manifest. two_independent_registered_checkers is recorded second: the manifest names two different checkers and both are registered. If either fails the run ends there, refused under the name of the first that failed.

The three registered checkers are residual.v1, tree_integration.v1 and length_only.v1. Each takes a potential. residual.v1 accepts when the cochain less the potential's coboundary is zero. tree_integration.v1 accepts when every cycle of the cochain sums to zero and the potential agrees with the integral of the cochain along a spanning forest, up to the value at vertex 0. length_only.v1 accepts a potential with a value for each vertex and checks nothing else.

The proposer is asked for a commitment alone, then for the reveal, an artifact (a list of exact integers) and the salt it used. reveal_matches_commitment holds when the SHA-256 of the salt, a zero byte and the canonical form of the artifact is the commitment given. A reveal that does not match is refused as ARTIFACT_CHANGED_AFTER_COMMIT.

For each checker, in the order of the manifest, NAME:accepts_artifact_and_gauge holds when it accepts the artifact and the artifact with every entry raised by three, and NAME:kills_every_mutant when it rejects every mutant: each entry raised by one and lowered by one, each unequal neighbouring pair swapped, and the artifact with its last entry left off. All held, the run is certified as COMMIT_REVEAL_CERTIFIED with kills, the number rejected out of the number tried for each checker.
boundaries: A certified run says the committed artifact survived two checkers and that every hostile edit of it was rejected by both. It does not say the checkers are right about anything but this cochain.
The salt is kept sealed. A salt in a prompt refuses the run as a sealed leak.
length_only.v1 is registered so that a weak checker can be named and refused. A manifest that names it cannot be certified.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
